visual_findings.result: Clearly the first readable identifying feature at 1x; broad pale band wraps shaded right face. No writing, arrow, ownership or permission marker.

Separate tan rope beneath white band, left protruding knot and loose end with negative gap are visible. Detailed knot construction is not certified; winding/knot is less immediately legible than band at 1x.
Desaturated dark green-brown lower cluster reads as tide staining, without barnacle noise or extra load-level marks.
Light left/front and dark right give rounded timber volume; flattened top is shallow enough for a useful camera study. Longer bright wood streak remains but does not destroy solid read.

42px visible height exceeds Jurg 34px; this reads as a tall landmark rather than a low mooring bollard. It is not intrinsically rejected, but actual shore placement, occlusion and intended marker height must determine final scale.

production_gates: Test 42px visible height and silhouette in intended shore placement, with walkable return route and occlusion; do not declare engine dimensions from this study.
Check dark-background right outline in actual scene and adjust only if it disappears; reviewer did not spend extra view on standalone dark-background image.
Check band/rope distinction at actual gameplay zoom; no same-object original sprite comparison exists.
pixel_log_review: edits.json contains exact coordinate, palette and reason, without before values. Independent replay from pre-edit bitmap reproduces exact result; reviewer reconstructs before/after while checking.
script_safety_review: Read reproduce.py and make_review.py fully. Both use local pathlib/Pillow/NumPy/json/hash operations. reproduce.py executed unchanged only in matching-depth /tmp mirror; comparison/manifest author script was not run against original folder.
reference_limits: No original same-object mooring-post sprite was located. Barrel/bookshelf/NPC/environment provide material, camera and comparison-scale evidence only.
Historical wiki references are not verified against installed 0.9.4.25 and do not establish reuse rights.
narrative_review: BRY-X11/CS-BRY-11 sources require visible return marker and real return path/boarding checks. A white band does not establish permission, ownership, ship handover, departure or task completion. No load marks or extra objects added.
boundaries: Only QA-independent.json written in candidate folder. No source PNG, old source, global index, runtime, upload or push mutations.
